spec: An exceptionally beautiful, cool and composed adult female sword adept with an elegant longer oval face, clear phoenix-shaped eyes and gently arched brows, a direct, luminous but restrained gaze. Long half-up hair in a broad asymmetric ink coil, a simple pale celadon pin, light blue and teal collar. Slight near-front turn.

An exceptionally beautiful, lively adult female traveler with a softly rounded face, sparkling expressive eyes, a bright but natural smile and graceful balanced features. Hair in TWO compact broad side coils with simple pale gold ties, no ponytail or red bow; coral and indigo collar. Slightly top-down front view.

An exceptionally beautiful theatrical adult female Jianghu rogue with high cheekbones, upward-set eyes and a poised mischievous half-smile. A single THICK dark side braid tied with wine-red cloth, bold plum and ochre high collar. Slight turn toward viewer's left.

A very beautiful adult female innkeeper with a sly, knowing smile, distinctive long almond eyes and calm charm. Hair in one broad low side knot with a restrained vermilion tie, deep wine-red collar. Slight turn left.

A very beautiful, bold female escort with a confident joyful smile, round expressive eyes and spirited presence. Dark hair mostly tucked beneath a broad ochre headwrap, no high ponytail; blue and rust-red collar. Near-front, chin slightly raised.

A very beautiful mature female sword teacher with a long balanced face, steady intelligent gaze and a composed, subtle smile. Broad dark hair in a horizontal low coil with one simple grey pin, dark green collar. Frontal pose.

A very beautiful mature female physician with soft laughing eyes, an individual oval face and a warm gentle smile. A single broad silver-grey streak in dark ink hair gathered into a compact low bun, muted plum and ivory collar. Slight turn toward viewer's right.

An exceptionally handsome adult male swordsman with dignified presence, bold masculine brows, vivid intelligent eyes, strong harmonious face and a restrained confident expression. Long dark hair in a broad high ponytail tied in wine-red cloth, charcoal and red collar. Near-front, chin slightly lifted.

An exceptionally handsome mature male hero with graceful masculine features, thoughtful eyes and a gentle confident smile. Dark hair with a SINGLE BROAD SILVER STREAK gathered in a low knot; pale ivory and deep green collar. Near-front slight turn.

An exceptionally handsome charismatic male performer with expressive narrow eyes, a defined but graceful jaw and a mischievous knowing smile. Dark hair slicked into a short wide knot with one large pale round ornament; plum and muted ochre-gold collar. Slight turn left.

A very handsome adult male traveler with a broad but harmonious face, warm expressive eyes and a friendly smile, individual not generic. Hair in a low wide knot held by a deep teal band; muted earthy-red and ivory collar. Near-front.

A very handsome carefree male musician with lively laughing eyes, a natural open smile and approachable charm. Broad dark hair held by an indigo headband, muted teal collar with rust-red edge. Slightly top-down front view.

A very handsome mature male martial artist with a strong square-oval face, composed gaze and subtle smile. Hair in a compact high knot with one simple grey pin; charcoal and rust collar. Near-front, slight low angle.

A very handsome elegant male traveler with a refined narrow face, bright intelligent eyes and an amused, confident half-smile. Long dark hair gathered into a broad low braid with a burgundy tie, jade-green and cream collar. Slight turn toward viewer's right.
